mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 66 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School, with a Waning Gibbous moon in the sky.

Road surface treatments are scheduled from August 4 to August 7, starting on Lincoln Street, and the city continues to offer a 100 dollar toilet rebate program for residents who switch to high-efficiency models to conserve water.

Today, we have the Remote Area Medical Clinic at the high school, along with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is available tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls, including an incident on July 26 where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. They are currently closed but will open their doors at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor.
